method: Deterministic fixture evaluation against frozen candidate rules; actual values are produced by this package script, not observed people or services.

test_suites.purpose: Surface every fixture sharing the frozen error version without admitting controls.
test_suites.failure_branch: If version provenance is missing or a control is surfaced, stop candidate expansion and keep the disputed rule off.

test_suites.purpose: Separate explainable inclusion from ambiguity; never auto-resolve missing fields.
test_suites.failure_branch: If any ambiguous fixture is auto-included or auto-excluded, return it to named human review and block remedy.

test_suites.purpose: Issue only refuseable notices through a human-approved route and delete links on exit.
test_suites.failure_branch: If no safe route exists, use passive public notice and protected human contact; do not expose a candidate link.

test_suites.purpose: Preserve ordinary service and complete the same review with paper lists and named staff.
test_suites.failure_branch: If paper tracing cannot reproduce the candidate and decision ledger, suspend the rehearsal and retain ordinary staffed service only.
